home.lede: Gikendam maajiiwewin ezhi-ayaawaad wiijiiwaa, ezhi-bimaadiziwin miinwaa ezhi-gaa-gaazhagemaad. Ininamewin, abinoojiinyag-mazinaate'iganan, maajiiwewin ezhi-ganawendamaang miinwaa mino-biidaasiwin mazinaate'iganan, bi-zhigoo gaa-dibaajimowaad miinwaa ginwaa-zhigoo mazinaate'iganan ezhi-gaa-nagadoonaan. Gaa-ayaawaad gaa-gii-kikinoo'amaagoowaad; gaa-dagoshinaad gakina.
facts: Pooniton aaniin apii go; gaawin gegoo gidaa-bwaanawi'osiin
home.heroApp: Miinawaa bishigendaagwad aabajichigan ondaje iPhone, iPad miinawaa Android, gidoodem mazinaakiziganan aabajitoodwaad
home.gamesLede: Endaso-odaminong bekaadad, gichi-aya'aa izhiwebad, miinawaa wezhitoong maajitaang. Onandan bezhig, wiijibim weweni, miinawaa memeshkwat tanginamook.

steps.title: Onandan gegoo gaa-nitaa-gikendaman
steps.text: Mazinaakiziganan aniibiishaabo-onaagansag, gitigaanag, awesiinyag miinawaa jiimaanensag. Gaawin agindamowin maagizhaa onaakonigewinan ji-gikinoo'amaagooyan nitam.

steps.title: Wiijibimok
steps.text: Bagaakoshkanawaa. Dibaajimok mazinaakiziganing. Giishpin baakaan naagwak, anishaa bibaa-bii'on ji-tangining miinawaa.

steps.title: Pooniton megwaa mino-ayaayan
steps.text: Bezhig odaminowin miziwe inakamigad. “Mii sa i'iw noongom” apane naagwad mazinaabikiigang.

home.stageLede: Madwewechigan, endaso-giizhig anokiiwinan, mikwendamowinan miinawaa bekaadakamigad mino-ayaawin, aanzhichigaade weweni ji-mino-inendaming noongom.

stages.title: Maajitaa-apii
stages.text: Ayaangwaamitoon gaa-zaagitoodwaad, bangii go aanzhichigaadeg: mino-anokiiwinan, gojiing izhaawin, ikidowin-odaminowinan miinawaa maamawi-inendamowin.
stages.label: Maajitaa-apii inendamowinan

stages.title: Naawii-apii
stages.text: Nenahii, nitaa-doodamowinan bibaaninjigaadegin: dagonigan, maawanji'igan, madwewechigan, mazinaakizigan-odaminowinan miinawaa akozi-bimoseng.
stages.label: Naawii-apii inendamowinan

stages.title: Baanimaa-apii
stages.text: Mino-inendamowin miinawaa wiidoopamowin tanginidiwining, noondaagwazing miinawaa waabandaming: oninji-ganawenindiwin, gaa-zaagitoodwaad nagamowinan, mazinaakiziganan miinawaa anishaa maamawi-ayaang.
stages.label: Baanimaa-apii inendamowinan

home.specificHtml: Ezhi-gikendaasiwaad ezhi-bimaadiziwin? Gaa-ayaawaad maajiiwewin miinwaa mamaajiiwewin Alzheimer's, wiidookaagewin miinwaa miigidoowin, dibaajimowin-mamaajiiwewin miinwaa wiidookaagewin.
home.approachLede: Gaa-maajiiwewin “mazinaate'iganan-ayaawin” gaa-ezhi-nagamowaad ezhi-wiidookaagewin, ezhi-gikendaaswin miinwaa gaa-bizhaawaad. Ezhi-maajiiwewin dementia-ing bimaadiziwag, ezhi-gaa-maadaaming miinwaa ezhi-gaa-giizhigaaming, gaawiin gaa-dagoshinaasi ezhi-gikendaasiwin. Ezhi-ayaawaad ezhi-ayaawaad.

principles.title: Gaawin gegoo gidaa-bwaanawi'osiin
principles.text: Gaawin diba'igiiziswan, diba'igan, bimaadiziwinan maagizhaa wanitowin. Baakaan mazinaakizigan anishaa booni-ayaawin, gaawin wanise-doodamowin.

principles.title: Mazinaakiziganan apane naagwadoon
principles.text: Gikendamowin ani-waabandaming, gaawin go nandawenjigaadenzinoon ji-mikwendaming. Gwayak maajisigaade daashki-naagwakin, mii wenji-gaawin gegoo mikwendamowin aabadasinoon.

principles.title: Gichi-aya'aa miinawaa manazomaagan
principles.text: Gizhaate, nenahii ikidowinan miinawaa gwayak-aki mazinaakiziganan. Gaawin wikaa abinoojiinh-mazinaabikiing maagizhaa binoojiing giigidowin.

principles.title: Gimodiziwin nitaa-gikendaagwad
principles.text: Gaawin ozhibii'igewi-mazina'igan maagizhaa adaawewinan. Gimazinaakiziganan gaawin wikaa da-maajaamagasinoon omaa gidaabajichiganing.

guides.title: Ezhi-maamawi-odaminong
guides.text: Ezhi-ozhichigaadeg, dadatabiwin, miinawaa ge-doodamang giishpin odaminowin poonigad minwendaming.

guides.title: Apii gaawiin ikidowaad inakamigiziwining
guides.text: Nitaa-inendamoog wenji-aazhidewendangig, miinawaa bishigendaagwad ezhi-gashkitoong baanimaa miinawaa.

guides.title: Ginwaa-ezhi-mazinaate'iganan ginwaa-ganawendamaang
guides.text: Ezhi-maajiiwewin ginwaa-gaa-ganawendamaang miinwaa maajiiwewin ezhi-ganawendamaang ezhi-ayaawaad ginwaa-biinjibaaying.

guides.title: 101 maajiiwewin mazinaate'iganan
guides.text: Ezhi-gikendaasiwin gaa-ezhi-maajiiwewin, gaa-ezhi-gikinoo'amaagoowaad ezhi-giiwewin miinwaa gaa-gichi-ezhi-bimaadiziwin.

home.researchText: Gidaa-naganaawaa na waninaagoziwin? O-wiidookawin na gidinendamowin-odaminowinan? Aaniin dash bagidinigewin, miijim, nibawin miinawaa noondamowin? Nenahii gwayak nakwewinan dibaajimowinang, miinawaa aandi gwayak gaa-zoongisinoog.
home.appTitle: Creative Activities omaa iPhone, iPad miinawaa Android
home.appText: O'ow bishigendagwak aabajichigan aabadad giishpin intanet asinoog miinawaa gidaa-aabajitoon gidoodem mazinaakiziganan gaa-onandaman, ganawendigaadewan omaa gidaabajichiganing. Bezhigwan bekaadakamigad: niiwin mangi-mazinaatesijiganan, gaawin diba'igiiziswan, gaawin diba'igan.

faq.a: Ezhi-wiidookaagewin gaa-ezhi-ayaawaad: gaa-nagadenimaad mazinaate'iganan ezhi-gikinoo'amaagoowaad, ezhi-zhaaganaashiimowaad, ezhi-zoongide'ewin ezhi-gaa-ayaawaad, gaa-dibaajimowaad gaa-ezhi-gikinoo'amaagoowaad, mazinaate'iganan-gaa-ayaawaad miinwaa dibaajimowin-mazinaate'iganan. Ezhi-ayaawaad dementia-ing bimaadiziwag. Gaa-ayaawaad ezhi-zhaaganaashiimowaad gaa-ayaawaad gaa-gikinoo'amaagoowaad. Gaawiin ezhi-gaa-bizhaawaad, gaawiin ezhi-gikendaasiwin gaa-ayaawaad.

Ahaaw. Gaawiin ginoodaagewin naadamaagewinan miinwaa gaawiin akawe ayaawaad Creative Activities wiinzaan. Naadamaagewinan ezhi-bimaadiziwaad nibiiwaabikoniwin web-browser ezhi-wiindamaang: phone, tablet, aanawaa computer.

Gaawiin wiidookaagewin gaa-ezhi-bimaadiziwaad dementia-ing gaa-ezhi-gaa-bebakaanaawaad, miinwaa Creative Activities gaawiin ezhi-ayaawaad gaa-ezhi-maajiiwewin miinwaa gaa-ezhi-bebakaanaawaad. Ezhi-wiidookaagewin gaa-ayaawaad ezhi-mino-bimaadiziwin miinwaa ezhi-ganawendamaang, gaawiin ezhi-dibaajimowaad ezhi-giiwewin.

Ahaaw. Alzheimer's dementia-wan gaa-ayaad apii, miinwaa naadamaagewinan ezhi-ayaawaad: mazinaigan gaa-ayaawaad, miijigeyaang, miinwaa gaawiin ezhi-gaa-ayaawaad wiijiiwaad. Mikwendaagozi naadamaagewin, nangwaakaajigewin, miinwaa dibaajimowinan gaa-ganawendang gaa-izhi-mawidiwaad.

Gaaweyaa, wiijiiwag ezhi-ayaad. Mazinaakanan Find the same miinwaa Picture pairs gaa-ayaad, aanawaa mazinaigan miinwaa anishinaabe ginoodaagewin. Ezhi-gii-naadamaagewin giiwenh, miinwaa miigwechiwiyaa ezhi-maajiigaadeg.

Site ayaawaad gaawiin akawe ayaawaad miinwaa gaawiin nakamowin. Google Analytics ezhi-giiwenh ezhi-nibiiwaabikoniwin mashkiiwaad. Mazinaigan Photo pairs gaa-ginoodaagewin giishpin browser-ayaawaad, gaawiin ezhi-ganawendang.

Creative Activities gaa-ayaawaad bebezhig ezhi-ganawendamaang ezhi-gikinoo'amaagoowaad, ezhi-mazinaate'iganan miinwaa ezhi-maajiiwewin ezhi-ganawendamaang wiijiiwaa, ezhi-ayaawaad web miinwaa ezhi-gaa-apiiyiwigaan. Gaawiin ezhi-gikinoo'amaagoowaad; gaawiin gaa-ezhi-giiwewin ezhi-wiidookaagewin.

about.bodyHtml:
Awegonen gaa-ezhi-ginwendaagozi

Ezhi-ganawendamaad ge-ezhi-bimaadiziwag: ikwe, ogaawaanzh, ikwe-binesiwaanzh, miinwaa wiin ezhi-dementia-wi bimaadiziwan. Ogaadiwag, gichi-bimaadiziwag miinwaa naadamowin-gikendamowag ge-ezhi-zhaaganashiimang ezhi-page-wi.

Gaa-ezhi-gikinoo'amaadiwin

Naadamowin mii gaa-ezhi-ayaad: dibaajimowin, miigwechiwin, mii sa gaa-ezhi-ganawaabandang ezhi-bimaadiziwin, mii dash ganawendang wiin. Gaawiin ezhi-gikinoo'amaadiwin ezhi-ganawendamowin wiin, gaawiin ezhi-ni-gaawiin.

Gichi-naadamowinan gaa-ezhi-ginwendaagozi zhaaganaashiimagad, gii-ezhi-gaawiin gaa-ni-gikinoo'amaadiwin. Gaa-ezhi-gaawiin mii weweni ezhi-ginwendaagozi wiin ezhi-gaa-bimaadiziwag. Ezhi-gikinoo'amaadiwin ge-ezhi-ginwendaagozi:

  • Gaawiin gaa-ni-gaawiin. Gaawiin zhoong, gaawiin gikinoo'amaadiwin, gaawiin ginoonde-gikinoo'amaadiwin, gaawiin gaa-ni-zhiishiwag, gaawiin gaa-bimaadiziwag, gaawiin dash ezhi-zhaaganashiimagad.
  • Gikendamowin ezhi-gaawiin gikendamowin. Gaa-ezhi-ayaad wiin ezhi-gikendamowin. Gaa-ezhi-ina'owaad ezhi-ganawaabandang, gaawiin ezhi-gikinoo'amaadiwin ezhi-gikendang ogiwiinaan.
  • Gichi, weweni miinwaa ezhi-ayaad. Gichi-dibaajimowin miinwaa gichi-ganawaabandang, weweni ezhi-ayaang, miinwaa ezhi-ayaad ezhi-ganawendang.
  • Gichi-bimaadiziwin. Gaawiin gaa-zhaaganaashiimang, gaawiin gaa-ni-zhiishiwag. Gaawiin emoji.
  • Ezhi-gaa-ganawendamowin. “Naadamowin giibaa” gaa-ayaa ezhi-gikendang. Gaa-ni-zhaaganaashiimagad ezhi-gaa-ganawendamowin giibaa dash ezhi-naadamowin.
  • Gii-ayaa gikinoo'amaadiwin. Gaawiin gaa-ni-ginwendaagozi, gaawiin ginwendaaganan. Ganawaabandang gaa-gii-zhaaganaashiimagad ayaa ezhi-gikinoo'amaadiwin.

Gaawiin gaa-ni-ginwendaagozi

Ii naadamowinan miinwaa ezhi-ganawendamowinan mii gaa-ezhi-gikendang miinwaa gaa-ezhi-naadamang. Gaawiin ezhi-dibaajimowin, gaawiin ezhi-gikinoo'amaadiwin, gaawiin ezhi-minwaabandang, gaawiin ezhi-medwewin, gaawiin ezhi-zoongide'iwin, gaawiin ezhi-ni-gaawiin dementia-wi gaa-gii-ni-Alzheimer's disease-wi. Gaawiin gaa-ni-ganawendamowin ezhi-ayaad dash ezhi-gikinoo'amaadiwin ezhi-gaawiin. Gaa-ezhi-gikinoo'amaadiwin gikendamowin ezhi-ayaad, gaa-ezhi-gaawiin ezhi-ganawaabandang naadamowin wiin.

Awegonen ezhi-gikendamowin

Creative Activities mii gichi-ganawendamowin ezhi-ayaad. Gaawiin medwewinan gaa-ezhi-ayaad. Gaa-ezhi-ginwendaagozi gaa-gikendang ezhi-ginwendaagozi gaa-ni-gikinoo'amaadiwag, National Institute on Aging miinwaa Alzheimer's Association, miinwaa ezhi-gikinoo'amaadiwin gaa-ni-ginwendaagozi. Waabandamaan awegonen gaa-ezhi-ginwendaagozi miinwaa gaa-ezhi-gikinoo'amaadiwin page-wi.

Gaa-ni-dibaajimowin awegonen ge-ezhi-ayaad

Gaa-ni-dibaajimowin awegonen gaa-ezhi-ina'owaad wiin, miinwaa awegonen gaa-ezhi-gaawiin, gichi-gaa-ni-zhaaganaashiimagad dementia-wi bimaadiziwag, ganawendamowin-ikwewag miinwaa naadamowin-gikendamowag. Ezhi-ginwendaagozi {email}.

editorial.title: Ezhi-ozhibii'amag gaye Ezhi-gikendamag Nimazina'iganinaan
editorial.description: Awegonen Creative Activities gaa-ezhi-gikinoo'amaadiwin, gaa-ezhi-ginwendaagozi, gaa-ezhi-ni-gikendang miinwaa ge-ezhi-zhaaganaashiimang naadamowin miinwaa bimaadiziwin page-wi, miinwaa awegonen gaawiin gaa-ni-ginwendaagozi.
editorial.bodyHtml:
Our sources

We base our guides on public guidance from organizations such as the National Institute on Aging, the CDC, the Alzheimer’s Association, the Alzheimer’s Foundation of America, the Family Caregiver Alliance and the NHS, and on peer-reviewed research such as Cochrane reviews and large clinical trials. Every guide lists the sources it relies on. We open each source before citing it, and we only report what it actually says.

How we write

  • Practical first: what to do today, in plain language.
  • Honest about evidence: we say “linked with”, “may” and “the evidence is mixed” when that is the truth.
  • Respectful: we write about people living with dementia as adults, and we never use quizzing or shaming language.
  • No invented content: no made-up statistics, quotes, experts, studies, reviews or testimonials.

Who reviews our pages

Pages are written and checked by the Creative Activities team. Some drafting and research use AI tools, as described below. Every page is checked against its sources by the team. Our pages have not been reviewed by a doctor or other clinician, and we do not claim otherwise. They are general information, not medical advice.

How AI is used

We use AI tools to help with research, first drafts, translation drafts and formatting. A person edits every page against its sources. AI does not test activities: a person tries each activity before it is published. No AI-generated step, image or review is presented as verified, and we do not publish AI-written reviews or testimonials. No generated image is shown as a photo of a real activity.

What we will never publish

  • Claims that a game, food, supplement, fast or routine prevents, treats, slows or cures dementia.
  • Tests, quizzes or scores that suggest someone has, or does not have, dementia.
  • Advice to start, stop or change any medicine.
  • Advertising or sponsored content disguised as guidance.

Updates and corrections

Each page shows the date it was last updated. If you find a mistake or an out-of-date source, please email {email} and we will check it promptly.

items.a: Gaa-onizhishingin odaminoowinan nagadendamowinaawan, weweni gashkitoonan, gaawiin dash gegoo mashkawinaasiin, mii go gaye gwayak ezhi-minwendang awiya noongom giizhigad. Naasab mazinaabijiganan ezhinaagwakin, baashkiziganan, wezhi'ichigewinan, gii-waawiindamang nagadendamowin-ikidowinan, zhooshkobii'igeng, gaye mazinaatese-bingo minosewag niibowa bemaadizijig. Baaga'adoosiin diba'igiiziswaan, agindasowinan, gaye gegoo ge-onji-inendang gagwedwewining.
Ahaaw. Gakina nagamowinan miinwaa ginwaabanjigewinan gaawiin bagidinaagoosiin, gaawiin akaunt, gaawiin ezhi-aanjibaawaad, gaawiin wiidookaagewin.

Dibaakwewinan miinwaa gikendamowinan ... ezhichigewin ge-ayaad gaa-mino-ganawendamaan ninaatoo ... Gaawiin ni-mino-dagoodaasiin, gaawiin ni-maajiigaasiin. Ginwaabamaa dakwaa gibiinaa ge-ganawenimigoyan ... Ezhi-giiwe igo gaawiin ...

Gakina giigoonikaaning, tablet ge-ayaang kiiwegamigong miinwaa kompyuter ge-ayaang gii-maajiiwaad ... Tablet ge-ayaang ... gaa-maajiinadaasiin ezhi-aabajitoong ... Laptop gaa-gaawiigwen TV ... miinwaa ezhi-zhaabwii gaye gaa-gikinoo'amaagewin ge-ayaang bemaadizijig.

items.q: Ambe dash ginwaabandaan bezhig ginwaabanjigewin gemaagwaan?
items.a: Ahaaw. Photo pairs ezhichigeyaan 2 miinwaa 6 ginwaabanjigewinan gaa-giiwe-gikendaman, ezhi-aanjibaawaad ezhi-gaa-goshkaadaawaad ezhi-wiinaad. Ginwaabanjigewinan ge-ayaad iwidi gwiiwizensan browser, gaawiin gaa-zhaawaad miinwaa gaawiin gaa-maajiinaawaad.

Gakina giishkaad 10 miinwaa 20 minitang gaa-dagoonaan, miinwaa niibin 2 minitang gaa-ayaawaad miikan. Ginwaabamaa ezhi-nagamowaad gaa-ganawendamaan ... Gaawiin ge-ayaa eta-gaa-gigoobii'igenan ... Ezhi-ayaa gaa-ginwaabamaan dibaakwewin.

Gaanwendam gaa-gowaad gaye ezhi-gii-agwajiwenag gaa-gikendamaan. Gaawiin gaa-ganawendamaasiin ... Ezhi-nagamowaad gaa-gowaad: gizhaagaa, gaawiin gaa-ganawenimigoosiin, gaawiin gaa-nagamowaasiin. Gaa-ganawendamaan wiigwaas-bagidinaan 'Ezhi-gii-maajiidooshkoo' gaa-aabajitoong.

Wiigiwaam miinwaa gaa-ginwaabandamaan: gaa-nagamowaad ginwaabanjigewinan miinwaa gaa-zhaabwiijiinaad ge-zhaagijigan, miinwaa gaa-zhaabwiijiinaad ezhi-gii-ganawenimigoyan. Ginwaabandaan gaye gichi-gegoo ezhi-gii-dibaakwaadaan miinwaa ezhi-ganawenimigaadaan ... Gichi-wiijiiwin gaa-gikendamaan gaa-zhiwebag ezhichigewinan ...

items.q: Ambe ezhichigewinan ge-ayaad bemaadizijig bagaajige-gegoo ezhi-ayaang?
items.a: Ahaaw. Picture bingo ezhi-ayaang ginwaabanjigewinan gaa-zhaabwii miinwaa on-screen caller, miinwaa Finish the saying miinwaa Conversation cards ezhi-zhaabwii gaa-nagamowaad. Groups guide gaa-gikendamaan gichi-bagaajige-gegoo, ezhi-dagoonaad miinwaa gaa-gikendamaan ezhi-aabajitoong.

Gaawiin ezhichigewin gaa-gikendaman gaa-ganawenimigoosiin dementia, miinwaa gaawiin gaa-nagamowaasiin ezhichigewinan ezhi-gii-dibaakwaadaan. Gikendamowin gaa-zhaabwii bemaadizijig gaa-ganawendang gii-aanjibaawaad miinwaa gaa-gikinoo'amaagewin gaa-agwaajiwendang, mii gaa-zhaabwii gichi-gii-ezhichigeyaan ... Gaawiin mii ezhichigewin ge-ganawenimigoosiin dementia. Ezhichigewinan gii-maajiigaanan gichi-wiijiiwin miinwaa gaa-gikendamaan.

Gaawiin ezhi-gikendamaan. Gikendamowin gaa-zhaabwii 14 gaa-ganawendamaan miinwaa ezhi-aabajitoong dementia gaa-zhaabwiiyaan, ezhi-gii-ganawendamaan gaa-dagoonaan, gaa-nagamowaad, gaa-bagaajige-gegoo ... Gaa-dooshkoo-ganawendamaan gaye gaawiin ezhi-gii-gikendamaasiin. Gaawiin gegoo gaa-zhichigenaan ... Gaawiin bemaadizid gaa-gii-wiijiiwin.

Gikendamowin gaa-zhaabwii gichi-gaawiin miinwaa gaa-nagamowin, miinwaa gaa-zhiwebag ezhi-gii-ayaad animal. Gaa-nagamowin gichi-gaawiin ezhi-gii-nagamowaad ge-gichi-gizhigaadegoyan, gaa-gikendamaan diabetes gaa-zhaabwiigan. Ezhi-gii-ganawendamaan doktor gaa-gikendaman ezhi-gii-zhichigeyaan.

Gaawiin akaunt, gaawiin zhaabwiijigewinan. Google Analytics gaa-zhaabwii gaa-dibaakwaadaan gaa-giiwe-maajiinaawaad miinwaa ezhi-gikendamaan gaa-nagamowaad ezhichigewinan. Browser gaa-zhaabwii gaa-gikendaman gaa-aanjibaawaad. Ginwaabanjigewinan gaa-giiwe-gikendaman Photo pairs gaawiin gaa-maajiinaawaad. Gikendamowin ezhi-gii-ganawendamaan gaa-zhaawaad.

Aaniin maamawinitijig ezhi-aabajitoodwaa

  • Ganawenjigewigamigoon gaye minjimendamowin-ganawenjigewigamigoon: mazinaate-bingo maagizhaa giizhitoon-ikidowin mawanji'idiwigamig mazinaateshichiganing, bezhig awiya e-tangishkaang onji maamawinitijig.
  • Gichi-aya'aa giizhig-anokiiwigamigoon: tablet-tasowi-danakamigad mazinaazowin-nizhichiganan niiwin mazina'iganan, onji gakina bezhig-gaye-bezhig anama'ewin.
  • Oodena-agindaasowigamigoon: mazina'igaadegin ikidowin-nandawaabam gaye gaganoonidiwin-mazina'iganan biinjayi'i minjimendamowin mashkimoding, gaye owe mazinaateshichigan e-atoodwaa agindaasowigamig tablets.
  • Gaa-ganawenimaajig wiidookoodaadiwigamigoon gaye minjimendamowin-wiisiniwigamigoon: bezhigobii'igan ge-gashkizhaagodeg mazina'igan onji inawemaaganag ji-giiwewidoowaad.
  • Aakoziwigamigoon gaye giiwewin-waawindamogeg: mazina'igan biinjayi'i gaa-ganawenimaajig mashkimoding, onji bekaadisichigewin endanaaniwang maagizhaa nibaaganing.

Wegonen gaa-inaabadizisinook

Odaminowinan ondaadiziwag ji-minawaanigoziying gaye ji-maamawi-ayaaying. Gaawiin aakoziwin o-mikawanzinoon, gagwedwewin ozhichigesinoon, agindaasowin dagonzinosinoon, noochimasinoon maagizhaa gaawiin bekaadizisinoon minjimendamowin-aanjisek, gaye gigagwedwemin anokiiwigamigoon gego iwi ezhi-dibaajimookegon. Gaawiin adaawewinan dagosinoon, gaye odaminowinan gaawiin gagwedwesinoon izhinikaazowinan, mino-bimaadiziwin dibaajimowinan maagizhaa mazinaabiki-mazinaazowinan ji-onda'amowaad. Owe mazina'igan o-doodaan Google Analytics ji-agindang bizaanyewinan; gidinwewinan giiwanimo-mazina'igan o-dibaadaan wegonen e-maamawinigaadeg. Mazinaazowinan e-aabajitoodwaa omaa Mazinaazowin-niizhooshichiganan ganawenjigaadewan biinjayi'i mazinaabikong.

Dagonamawishinaam gidinaakonigewin-mazina'iganing

Kishpin ayaaman mazina'igan onji gaa-ganawenimaajig, gigichi-inendagoz ji-aaniikoobii'iyan omaa {domain}. Gidaa-naasabiibii'aan awe-gaye-awe dibaajimowin.

app.seoTitle: Creative Activities App onji iPhone gaye Android
app.description: Diba'igasinoo Creative Activities app: bedaatenimagak mazinaazowin-nizhichigan niiwin mishi-mazina'iganan, inawemaaganag mazinaazowinan ganawenjigaadewan gidoonaaganikong, nibiina mazinaazowin-mashkimodaan gaye gaawiin ozhibii'igazosinoon.
app.lede: Gakina gegoo menwendaman omaa mazina'iganing, biinjayi'i app anokiimagad gego aaniikoobii'isig gaye gidaa-aabajitoonan inawemaaganag mazinaazowinan gaa-onapinamowan.
app.bodyHtml:
Pangi madaanii

Niiwin mangi-mazina'iganensan gaye mazinaakiziganan gaa-nagadendamingin madaanii. Ganawaabandamook mazinaakiziganan ji-naabaminagwadinig, maagizhaa gidinawaan giishpin iji-minwendameg. Bangan-odaaminowin gaawiin diba'igiiziswaan, agindasowin maagizhaa angoziwin ayaasinoon. Onapidon 4, 6, 8 maagizhaa 12 mazina'iganensan.

Gidoodeminaan da-inendaagwad

Onapidon enawemadwaa omazinaakiziganiwaan omaa gaa-aabajitooyan. App odashtoon agaasaagin mazinaakiziganan ji-aabajitoong odaaminowining. Gaawiin andawaabandanzinoon gakina gaa-ateg maagizhaa ji-aanjitood gi-mazinaakiziganiwaan, gaye gashkitoomagad ji-ganawendang miziwe eta 24 mazinaakiziganan bezhigong.

Mawandoodaa ganawaabandang

Bezhig eta mazinaakizigan pezhigong ganawaabandan. Gagwedwewinensan noonde-gagwe-gaganonidiing, gaawiin awiya gagwejimasiin ji-mikitood wiinzo-mazinaate maagizhaa ji-gwayakwendang. Eta ganawaabandaming debise.

Aabadan misawaa gaawiin internet ayaasinoon

Madaa-mazinaakiziganan gaye gakina nishwaaswi mazinaakizigan-mashkimodan dagoshinoon omaa app-ing. Mazinaakiziganan gaa-biindigadooyeg aabadanoon misawaa gaawiin internet ayaasinoon. Mazinaakiziganan gaa-ategin iCloud eta maagizhaa odaapinamang internet ji-gashkitoong.

Gaawiin ozhibii'iganens, gaawiin gaye asanjigewigamig

Gidoodem mazinaakiziganan atewan omaa app-ing gaa-aabajitooyan. Gidaa-aangoshkaan iniw mazinaakiziganan gaawiin dash ji-wanaajitoodan gaa-oshki-mazinaakiziganan. Gaa-aabajitooyan gaa-ganawendaming maagizhaa dagoshinomaa app-wiindamaagewinan. Agindan app privacy policy, gaye app help wiindamaagemagad aaniin ji-izhitood pangi eta.
app.disclaimer: Creative Activities aabadan ji-minwendaming gaye ji-gaganonidiing. Gaawiin onji-nanaandawi'iwesinoon, gaawiin odino-noojitoosinoon, gaawiin ogiba'anzinoon, gaye gaawiin odibaabandanzinoon wanishkweyendamowin maagizhaa Alzheimer’s aakoziiwin.

faq.a: Mazinaakizigan-niizhodewag niiwin mazina'iganensan bangan-madaa-onapidamowin aawan. Giishpin mazinaakiziganan onaabandang sanagad aawan, gagwejitoodaa Mikaw bezhigo-mazinaakizigan niizhin mazinichiganing. Niibina giishpin ayawaad, gagwejitoodaa Mazinaakizigan-bingo.

faq.q: Aabadanoon na iniw odaaminowinan omaa iPad maagizhaa giigidowining?
faq.a: Enya. Endaso-odaaminowin aabadan omaa browser giigidowining, tablets gaye mazinaabik-asiganing, gaye mazinaakiziganan mangishkaamagadoon ji-moshkinebiig mazinaateshiganing. Tablet asanjigaadeg ganabatash naawiji-minwendang niizh awiya.

faq.q: Onizhishinoon na owe odaaminowinan awiya wenji-wanendang Alzheimer's?
faq.a: Enya. Ozhichigaadewan aabajitoowaad wenji-wanishkwendangig, gaye a’aw wenji-wanendang Alzheimer’s, gaa-maamawi-michaag. Mazinaakiziganan naabaminagwadoon, pangi eta atewan onapidamowinan, gaye gaawiin gegoo diba'igiizisowaasiin maagizhaa agindaswaasiin, mii dash iniw odaaminowinan aabajitoong ji-kikendaming nagadendamingin kakina gaawiin dash oshki-mikwendamowin.

Ezhi-mizhakewinan gaa-ayaawaad, gichi-aya'aawan gaa-miinigoowaad mizhakewinan, gaawiin gaa-gikinoo'amaagewaad: gaa-ayaawaad Picture pairs, dibaakwewin bizaanikaaning gaa-ayaawaad. Gaa-mizhakewaad memory game gaa-ayaawaad gaawiin timers ige scores.

faq.q: Ayawan na odaaminowinan maamawi-aabajitoowaad aaniindi ganawenindiwaad?
faq.a: Enya. Mazinaakizigan-bingo ayaamagad mazina'iganensan ji-mooka'ang gaye mazinigewin mazinaateshiganing, gaye Giizhitaa ikidowin gaye Gaganonidiwin-mazina'iganensan mino-aabadanoon aagindan enjibaamagag maamawi.

appFacts.summary: Gaawiin diba'igaadesinoon app omaa iPhone, iPad gaye Android aabajitoowaad bangan mazinaakizigan-nandawaabamidiwin niiwin miziwe eta midaaswi-ashi-niizh mangi-mazina'iganensan, nandawaabamidiwin gaye ganawaabandaming gidoodem-mazinaakiziganan gaa-onapidaman, gaye nishwaaswi mazinaakizigan-mashkimodan aabadanoon misawaa gaawiin internet ayaasinoon. Gaawiin ozhibii'igan, adaawewinan, diba'igiiziswaan maagizhaa agindasowin.
features: Bangan mazinaakizigan-nandawaabamidiwin aabajitoong 4, 6, 8 maagizhaa 12 mangi-mazina'iganensan; mazinaakiziganan naabaminagwadoon eta giishpin bakaan inendaman ji-gidinawan
Gidoodem-mazinaakiziganan gaa-onapidaman biindigadewan omaa app-ing ji-nandawaabamidiming gaye ji-maamawi-ganawaabandaming
Maamawi ganawaabandan: bezhig mazinaakizigan pii bezhig gaye gagwedwewinensan ji-gaganonidiing
Nishwaaswi mazinaakizigan-mashkimodan dagoshinoon omaa app-ing; aabadanoon misawaa gaawiin internet ayaasinoon
Gaawiin ozhibii'igan, adaawewinan, app-adaawewinan, diba'igiiziswaan, agindasowin maagizhaa angoziwin

faq.a: Enya. Creative Activities (ozhibii'igaade omaa "{storeName}") gaawiin diba'igaadesinoon omaa App Store gaye Google Play. Atewan bangan mazinaakizigan-nandawaabamidiwin aabajitoong mangi-mazina'iganensan, odaaminowinan gidoodem-mazinaakiziganan gaa-onapidaman, gaye mazinaakizigan-mashkimodan aabadangig misawaa gaawiin internet ayaasinoon.

faq.q: Gaawiin na diba'igaadesinoon owe Creative Activities app?
faq.a: Enya. Gaawiin diba'igaadesinoon ji-biidoong, gaawiin adaawewinan, ozhibii'igan maagizhaa app-adaawewinan.

faq.q: Aabadan na owe app misawaa gaawiin internet ayaasinoon?
faq.a: Enya. Madaa-mazinaakiziganan gaye gakina nishwaaswi mazinaakizigan-mashkimodan dagoshinoon omaa app-ing, gaye gidoodem-mazinaakiziganan aabadanoon misawaa gaawiin internet ayaasinoon apii biindigadoong omaa app-ing. Mazinaakizigan gaa-asanjigaadeg iCloud eta maagizhaa odaapinamang internet ji-gashkitoong.

Enya'. Onaabandan mazinaakizonan imaa gidaabajichiganing. O'ow aabajichiganens ogashkiton ji-ategin agaasaag mazinaakizonan imaa gidaabajichiganing ji-aabajitood, gaawiin ningoji odaa-maajiisidoosiin, gaye gaawiin wikaa odaa-aanjitoosiin nitam gaa-inaandeg. Gidaa-aangisidoonan iniw mazinaakizonan aapiji megwaa go e-ndawendaman.

faq.q: O'ow ina aabajichiganens ji-kikinoo'amaagemagak mikwendamowin maagizhaa ji-gwejichigaadeg gaa-mikwendaman?
faq.a: Gaawiin. Creative Activities gaa-onji-ojichigaadeg ji-minwendaming miinawaa ji-maamawii-ayaang. Gaawiin atekasinon agindaasowin maagizhaa gwejinang, miinawaa gaawiin wiindamagesinon, nooji'isinon, gibitinzinon, maagizhaa dibaabandanizinon e-ani-wanitoojin o-mikwendamowin maagizhaa Alzheimer aakoziwin.

gameFaqYes.a: Enya'. O'ow Creative Activities aabajichiganens gaa-diba'igaadesinook ji-aabajitood iPhone, iPad gaye Android gego dagonoozoosiwan, bekaaji-aanikoobidoon mazinaakizonan, gidaa-aabajitoonan gidoo-deshkan-inawemaaganag o-mazinaakizowiniwaan gaa-onaabandaman, gaye anokiimagad misawaa gaawiin Wi‑Fi ayasinook. Gaawiin mazina'igan, adaawewin-mazinaakiganan, maagizhaa agindaasowin ayaasinon.

gameFaqNo.a: Gaawiin omaa odaminowining. O'ow Creative Activities aabajichiganens gaa-diba'igaadesinook ji-aabajitood iPhone, iPad gaye Android gego dagonoozoosiwan, bekaaji-aanikoobidoon mangishaaniwan mazinaakizonan gaye gidoo-deshkan-inawemaaganag o-mazinaakizowiniwaan gaa-onaabandaman, gaye anokiimagad misawaa gaawiin Wi‑Fi ayasinook. O'ow odaminowin apane bizhishigwago giga-odamin omaa gidaabajichigan-waakaa'iganing.

gamePage.noscript: O'ow odaminowin nandawendam JavaScript ji-biindigenaagwad omaa gidaabajichiganing. Odoo-gikinoo'amaagewinan omaa naamiing anokiimagadoon misawaa gaawiin atezinoog.

print.heading: Mizhakewin gaa-bagidinaawaad
print.sameRules: Gaa-bagidinaawaad mizhakewin gaa-ayaawaad ezhi-mizhakewin gaa-ayaawaad kaadenaganan:
print.pageNote: Bangii page A4 ige US Letter, gaawiin ezhi-mashkawaad black ige white. Version {date}.
print.point: Gaa-bagidinaawaad, gaa-ayaawaad waa-dibaakonaadiwaad picture gaawiin tap gaa-izhichigewaad, ige circle gaa-izhichigewaad pen-iwe. Each row ezhi-ayaawaad gaa-ayaawaad.
print.pointTarget: Gaa-bagidinaawaad, picture gaa-ganawaabandaan box gaa-ayaawaad start of each row. Dibaakonaadiwaad picture gaawiin tap, ige circle gaa-izhichigewaad pen-iwe.
print.halves: Each picture gaa-dazhi-zhaabaawaad middle. Draw a line from each half gaa-ayaawaad left to half gaa-ayaawaad right gaa-ezhi-biidaabiigewaad, ige point gaa-izhichigewaad finger-iwe. Gaawiin gaa-kiiwin needs cutting.
print.grid: Each square gaa-ayaawaad number. Find number gaa-ayaawaad key, ige color square gaa-ayaawaad pencil gaa-ayaawaad color. Any other color gaa-miinigoowaad fine too. Gaawiin gaa-kiiwin needs cutting.
print.colors: Each row gaa-ayaawaad color gaa-dibaakwewaad. Point to every picture gaa-ayaawaad color, ige circle gaa-izhichigewaad pen-iwe. Each row ezhi-ayaawaad gaa-ayaawaad.
print.dice: Each row gaa-ayaawaad set of dice. Pick row, ige cut pictures out gaa-ayaawaad draw gaa-ayaawaad pile-iwe, then tell story gaa-ayaawaad any order. Anyone may pass.
print.words: Cut out words, ige draw line from each word gaa-ayaawaad picture. Read words aloud gaa-ayaawaad.
print.cards: Cut out cards along dashed lines. Lay them face up gaa-ayaawaad table, then find pairs.
print.chain: Gaa-bagidinaawaad, read pictures from left to right, one after other. Each person says one sentence gaa-ayaawaad pictures so far, then points to next picture. Anyone may pass.
print.sort: Cut out pictures along dashed lines, then put each one gaa-ayaawaad box gaa-ayaawaad belongs.
print.puzzle: Cut large picture along dashed lines into four pieces ige mix them up. Swap two pieces at a time until picture is whole. Small picture gaa-ayaawaad guide.
print.cutSafety: Helper gaa-kiiwin cut before you start. Put scissors away afterwards.

reasons.photos: Gaawiin gaa-bagidinaawaad mizhakewin. Game gaa-ayaawaad your own photos, gaa-ayaawaad browser, gaawiin gaa-bagidinaawaad. Gaa-mizhakewaad, bagidinaan two copies gaa-ayaawaad favorite photos, ige match them gaa-ayaawaad table.
reasons.paced: Gaawiin gaa-bagidinaawaad mizhakewin. Circle gaa-ayaawaad slow pace gaa-ayaawaad screen, ige printed page gaawiin gaa-izhichigewaad, so it would be different activity. Quiet pause together gaawiin screen gaa-ayaawaad always option.
reasons.turns: Gaawiin gaa-bagidinaawaad mizhakewin. Gaa-mizhakewaad pairs gaa-ayaawaad table, bagidinaan picture cards gaa-ayaawaad Picture pairs, ige take turns turning them over.
reasons.screen: Ei ole paperiversiota. Tämä on kuva, jota katsotaan yhdessä ruudulta; pöydällä oleva lempikuva tai postikortti tekee saman asian.
reasons.wash: Ei ole paperiversiota. Vesiväri paperille on sama idea: märkä sivellin ja yksi väri kerrallaan.
reasons.sayings: Paperiversiota ei ole vielä. Paperilla jokainen loppu näkyisi heti, ja hellävarainen "Näytä loppu" -vaihe katoaisi. Lukekaa sanonnat yhdessä ruudulta tai jakakaa muutama, jonka te molemmat tunnette.
